stream.why: In streaming mode a cut-off SSE stream raises langchain_openai OpenAIConnectionError (Connection error.) and is not retried; non-streaming requests are retried and PASS.

mcp-protocol-error.why: langchain-mcp-adapters raises mcp McpError for a JSON-RPC error; the prebuilt ReAct agent does not catch it, so the run ends before a tool result is sent.

mixed-content.why: LangChain sends the image as an image_url part inside the role:tool message, a shape Chat Completions tool messages do not support; reported as an unsupported request shape.

embedded-resource.why: The blob resource (image/png) is sent as an image_url part inside the tool message, which Chat Completions tool messages do not support; reported as an unsupported request shape.

resource-link.why: langchain-openai raises ValueError ('OpenAI Chat Completions does not support file URLs') and the run ends.

audio-content.why: langchain-mcp-adapters raises NotImplementedError ('AudioContent conversion to LangChain content blocks is not yet supported') and the run ends.
